details: Chromatitle@1.0.0, a terminal banner/color CLI, executes a hidden download-and-execute payload automatically when the module is imported. Its bundled src/utils/bootstrap.js is heavily obfuscated (encoded string array with a custom decoder) and imports child_process execFile, http/https get, and fs write/chmod/unlink/mkdir. On import it fetches a remote file from an obfuscated URL (with a query parameter), writes it to the OS temp directory, chmods it executable, and executes it via execFile. The remote host is encoded inside the obfuscated string array.
